about: Item 14 (the board's cast), prepared WHILE the Episode 1 render runs: the plan for cutting the three new Tripo bodies into the sections our skeleton wears, applied to library/ai-parts.json + tools/ai_part.py once the render is done (the render stamp covers ai-parts.json and assets/models/ai). Fits from tools/body_plan.py (neck / shoulder-top: Ronin 88/84%, Monk 84/82%, Noblewoman 82/80%; Kojiro's proven fit sits 4% under the shoulder top). Sheets from the concepts (output/tripo/cast/*-concept-1.image.png) against library/paper-materials. Section boxes start from Kojiro's validated kojiro_*_t1 boxes and are judged on a pose-sweep render, as his were.

ronin.look: torn cream kimono and trousers (ragged hems), red obi, black hair, straw sandals with black ankle wraps
ronin.notes: the ragged hem is the character: keep the torn edges in the leg sections (do not let the cut line straighten them); the board's ragged-ronin parts (hood, woven kasa, patched vest, torn skirt, rope sandals, backpack) are accessories on top once the boards arrive as files

monk.look: shaved head, dark brown robe, cream kesa stole across the chest, wooden prayer beads at the neck, cream trousers, white tabi and sandals
monk.notes: the robe falls below the knee: the skirt section takes the robe from the obi line down (rigid on the hips first; paper-cloth or layered plates later, item 17); the beads ride the chest bone (part of the torso section)

noblewoman.look: black hair with red kanzashi, cream kimono with long sleeves, red obi with long tails, red under-skirt, white tabi
noblewoman.notes: no legs to cut: the kimono and the red under-skirt are ONE skirt section on the hips (body_plan found no gap between the legs); long furisode sleeves are the first layered-plate candidates (item 17); the obi tails are a free part (paper cloth)

then: prepare every section (tools/ai_part.py, AI_PART_DUMP=1 for the paint clusters -> palettes)
the validator (engine/validate.mjs) and the 5-pose sweep render, judged like kojiro-ai2
the line-up render: Ronin, Samurai, Noblewoman, Monk, Assassin, Warrior (the board's order)
